subject: Co-sell: staggered breakout plan + recording capture for marketplace demo
messages:
From: Lara Cheng <lara.cheng@aws.amazon.com>
To: Sofia Ivanova <sofia.ivanova@redwood.com>, Vanessa Ortiz <vanessa.ortiz@redwood.com>
Cc: AWS Marketplace AM <aws-marketplace@amazon.com>
Date: Mon, 29 Jul 2028 09:14:00 -0400
Subject: Redwood x Helix — co-sell demo slot request (marketplace listing prep)

Hi Sofia and Vanessa,

Thanks again for agreeing to a marketplace co-sell demo with Helix Systems. AWS Marketplace wants to include a short recorded demo that we can attach to the listing page — ideally a 30–35 minute session followed by 2 short regional breakouts (APAC / EMEA) for local SI follow-ups.

Can we lock a demo window next week (Aug 6–8)? Typical attendees: AWS AM, Helix pre-sales (Tom), our marketplace listing specialist, and Redwood product + solutions.

Two asks:
- Confirm a 35-min core demo + 20-min simultaneous regional breakouts (we can stagger by 10 min if needed).
- Let us know if Redwood can record and export a single composite recording (for AWS listing) and share any compliance checklist needed.

Lara
AWS Marketplace

From: Sofia Ivanova <sofia.ivanova@redwood.com>
To: Lara Cheng <lara.cheng@aws.amazon.com>, Vanessa Ortiz <vanessa.ortiz@redwood.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>, Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood.com>
Date: Mon, 29 Jul 2028 11:02:00 -0400
Subject: Re: Redwood x Helix — co-sell demo slot request (marketplace listing prep)

Thanks Lara — we can do that. Proposed approach:

- Core session: 35 minutes demo + 10 minutes quick Q&A (45 total block)
- Two staggered breakouts: EMEA starts immediately after core +10 min buffer; APAC breakout starts +20 min (so hosts can rotate)
- Redwood will record the core session and capture the breakout streams; we can produce a single trimmed recording for AWS.

Available windows: Aug 6 (14:00–16:00 UTC), Aug 7 (15:00–17:00 UTC), Aug 8 (13:00–15:00 UTC). Please confirm preferred date and whether the 10/20 min stagger works for Helix.

I[0m
Sofia Ivanova
Head of Strategic Partnerships | Redwood Inference

To: Sofia Ivanova <sofia.ivanova@redwood.com>, Vanessa Ortiz <vanessa.ortiz@redwood.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>, Lara Cheng <lara.cheng@aws.amazon.com>
Date: Tue, 30 Jul 2028 08:22:00 -0400
Subject: Re: Redwood x Helix — co-sell demo slot request (marketplace listing prep)

Appreciate the quick turnaround. A couple of notes from Helix pre-sales:

- Our SI lead (APAC) needs a 25-minute technical breakout to show integration patterns — will that be a separate channel we can record?
- Compliance: our procurement team wants assurance the recording can be stored in our S3 (well provide a signed transfer agreement).
- Also: can we do a short rehearsal (30 mins) 48 hours prior to the event focused on the integration flow?

If Aug 7 works, wed like rehearsal on Aug 5 afternoon (APAC-friendly). CC'ing Marissa to align on rehearsal runbook.

—Tom
Tom Rivas
Principal Solutions Architect | Helix Systems
From: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>
To: Tom Rivas <tom.rivas@helixsys.com>, Sofia Ivanova <sofia.ivanova@redwood.com>
Cc: Vanessa Ortiz <vanessa.ortiz@redwood.com>, Lara Cheng <lara.cheng@aws.amazon.com>
Date: Tue, 30 Jul 2028 10:05:00 -0400
Subject: Re: Redwood x Helix — rehearsal/runbook + attachments

Tom — thanks. Ive attached our latest runbook (redwood-breakout-runbook-v2.pdf) and a proposed scope matrix (helix-scope-matrix.xlsx). Key points:

- We will provision 3 Zoom channels: core (recorded), breakout-EMEA (recorded), breakout-APAC (recorded). Redwood will own the composite recording workflow and can provide the MP4 and a trimmed 10–12 minute highlight reel for AWS.
- Rehearsal: Aug 5 16:00 UTC — 30 minutes (shared agenda in the runbook).
- Data transfer: Redwood can drop the final files into a pre-authorized S3 bucket or share via a secure transfer link. Please send the Transfer Agreement by EOD tomorrow so legal can queue.

Can Helix confirm presenters for each breakout (names + emails) so we can pre-provision recording permissions?

Marissa Cole
Partner Programs | Redwood Inference

Attachments: redwood-breakout-runbook-v2.pdf (10 pages, runbook) ; helix-scope-matrix.xlsx (1 sheet)

Quick confirmation from ops side:

- Weve reserved Aug 7, 15:00–16:00 UTC for the demo (core 15:00–15:45 UTC, EMEA breakout 15:55, APAC breakout 16:15 stagger).
- Rehearsal set for Aug 5, 16:00 UTC.
- Redwood will enable recording and share the raw files within 24 hours. Please note: recordings will contain participant video/audio — Helix, confirm you have permission from all presenters to be recorded.
- For the listing, AWS asked for a single narrated MP4 (12–15 min highlight). Redwood will produce that as a deliverable.

Ill send calendar invites and a single consolidated slide deck request (one deck per presenter) — can Helix and AWS upload materials to the shared Drive link below by Aug 3?

Drive: https://drive.google.com/drive/folders/marketplace-helix
